title: Austin's Early Transit & Urban Plans
summary:
*   **Jitney Boom & Regulation:** Six new licenses were granted for Ford jitneys (early shared taxis), establishing detailed routes from downtown to 31st Street, operating on fixed schedules and requiring financial bonds.
*   **Flexible Transit Routes:** Jitney services saw a temporary rerouting due to a bridge closure on Speedway at 29th Street, adjusting northern termini and adding downtown segments to maintain service during construction.
*   **Urban Development & Land Use:** The council passed an ordinance to vacate and dedicate streets in a re-subdivision of land near Pease Park, indicating active city planning and growth.
*   **Investing in Public Safety:** Significant personnel appointments were made across multiple Fire Department companies, including captains and hosemen, alongside appropriations for new equipment like a life net and fire horses.
*   **Financial Adjustments & Citizen Redress:** A large $1,586 property assessment declared in error was cancelled, and smaller refunds were approved for overpaid taxes, including compensation for a calf killed by a live wire.

May 22nd 1916:
The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Whereas, in view of the fact
that the bridge across Speedway at 29th street in this City has been closed for the
construction of a new bridge at that point, and in view of the fact that said bridge at
Speedway and 29th st may remain closed for from two to three months ,and in view of the
fact that certain individuals operating a jitney line of automobiles whose present route
goes from fifth to thirty-first streets,have requested the privilege of making up the loss
in distance of said route by reason of their inability to traverse Speedway for a portion
of the route heretofore prescribed for them, and in view of the special fact that the
intersection of 27th street with Speedway is an inconvenient ,if not very dangerous, place
for the terminus for a line of jitney cars,
Now, therefore,

car operators to add two blocks ,from 3rd to 5th streets in this City ,as a substitute for
the shortening of their distance on the route from 27th to 29th streets ,be granted, and
Be it further resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin : That their terminal

street ,in place of 31st street where it intersect Speedway.
